silhouette.reason: A set with three shape families now (round, angular, slab) and a pebble scatter; each outline reads as a boulder.
fixes: one taller, more angular split block so the set is not all low domes

proportions.reason: Sizes from a 0.4 m cobble to a ~2 m boulder, bases sunk into soil patches as asked.
fixes: vary the burial depth so one boulder is half-buried

materials.reason: Granite with lichen blotches reads as stone at a distance, but in hero.png the albedo is soft and blurry, the soil patches are flat dark mats with hard polygon edges, and the pebbles are smooth white pills that read as plastic.
fixes: feather the soil patch edges (alpha or vertex fade into the ground) instead of a hard polygon mat
pebbles in varied grey/brown values with a rough surface, not uniform white
sharper granite grain (feldspar/quartz flecks) in granite.ts

detail.reason: Fracture planes on the angular boulder and the slab hold, but edges are rounded and soft in the hero and there is no crack or fissure detail.
fixes: sharper fracture edges (less smoothing on the cuts) and a few cracks/fissures

wear.reason: Lichen, moss on the north faces, soil and pebbles at the bases tell where they lie.
fixes: darker damp band at the soil line and moss in the crevices, not only blotches on top

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 keeps the shapes, but the soil patches become hard octagons and the big boulder's colour shifts darker.
fixes: keep the LOD0 albedo average on LOD2 faces and round the soil patches with more sides

technical.reason: QA clean; 35k / 5k / 0.4k triangles, 1 draw for the set.
fixes: coarser LOD0 cell on the smallest boulder
